description: This is a Dart source file defining a Flutter widget for a login screen. It provides a user interface for email/password authentication, interacts with backend API via ApiClient to perform login and token validation, and navigates to the home screen upon success.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that renders a login form with email and password fields, manages login logic including API interaction, token storage, and navigation upon success.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen handling form validation, user input, API calls, and UI updates during login process.

methods.name: _onLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process: validates form, calls API to login, verifies token, stores token in app state, and navigates to home screen. Handles errors and updates UI state.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes controllers and API client resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the login screen, including form fields, error messages, and login button with loading indicator.
